name: Death Roll
body:
Death Roll (Ex)
Source Ultimate Magic pg. 33
While grappling an enemy up to one size category larger than you, you may make a grapple check to roll wildly, knocking your enemy prone and dealing 1d8 points of damage. When using this ability, you gain a bonus to your CMB equal to one half your druid level (minimum 1). You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.
